adjudication.query:
WITH current_dim AS (
  SELECT source_path, is_current, superseded_by
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true
), selected AS (
  SELECT 'AIC'::text AS method, n_images, aic_pred_ms AS observed_ms, is_valid, note, source_path
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/anchor_dense_sdpa_2400.json' AND n_images IN (1, 8, 32, 64)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HF-SDPA', n_images, mean_ms, is_valid, note, source_path
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/anchor_dense_sdpa_2400.json' AND n_images IN (1, 8, 32, 64)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HF-FA2', n_images, mean_ms, is_valid, note, source_path
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE engine = 'flash_attention_2' AND image_px = 448 AND n_images IN (1, 8, 32, 64)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'vLLM-FA', n_images, mean_ms, is_valid, note, source_path
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE ((n_images = 1 AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_dense.json') OR (n_images IN (8, 32, 64) AND source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_vit.json'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'compile', n_images, mean_ms, is_valid, note, source_path
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vit_compile_dense.json' AND n_images IN (1, 8, 32, 64)
), per_cell AS (
  SELECT method, n_images,
         MIN(observed_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_valid) AS valid_observed_ms,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid) AS valid_row_count,
         MIN(observed_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_valid) AS invalid_observed_ms,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_valid) AS invalid_row_count,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT note, ' | ') FILTER (WHERE NOT is_valid) AS invalid_note,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.source_path IS NOT NULL) AS current_dim_matches
  FROM selected s
  LEFT JOIN current_dim d USING (source_path)
  GROUP BY method, n_images
), aic AS (
  SELECT n_images, valid_observed_ms AS aic_ms FROM per_cell WHERE method = 'AIC'
), vllm AS (
  SELECT n_images, valid_observed_ms AS vllm_ms FROM per_cell WHERE method = 'vLLM-FA'
)
SELECT p.method, p.n_images, p.valid_observed_ms, p.valid_row_count,
       p.invalid_observed_ms, p.invalid_row_count, p.invalid_note,
       p.current_dim_matches,
       CASE WHEN p.method = 'vLLM-FA' THEN ROUND((v.vllm_ms / a.aic_ms)::numeric, 4) END AS vllm_aic_ratio
FROM per_cell p
LEFT JOIN aic a USING (n_images)
LEFT JOIN vllm v USING (n_images)
ORDER BY CASE p.method WHEN 'AIC' THEN 1 WHEN 'HF-SDPA' THEN 2 WHEN 'HF-FA2' THEN 3 WHEN 'vLLM-FA' THEN 4 WHEN 'compile' THEN 5 END, p.n_images
